title: Annotatio IV §.XIV: Paschal Homily — what is seen is bread; spiritually understood is Life
pass_a_gloss: What is seen is bread; what is understood SPIRITUALLY is Life. (Paschal Homily hinge after the FIGURE/truth contrast.)
pass_b_english: The Homily hinge: eyes meet bread.
Faith understanding meets Life — spiritual reading of the same host.
source_text: Quod videtur, panis est; quod SPIRITUALITER intelligitur, Vita est.
